The episode ended on a cliffhanger — we had to know what happened next.
Streaming services have changed the way families watch television.
We pay a monthly subscription to watch unlimited films and series.
This series has five seasons and over sixty episodes in total.
The whole family gathered to watch the season premiere together.
There was nothing new on TV so we watched a rerun of an old favourite.

stage_2_story.text_en: Friday night had become the Levi family's streaming night. As soon as dinner was cleared, the children ran to the sofa. They had been waiting all week for the new episode of their favourite series — a funny adventure show that had just started its second season. Dad set up the streaming service on the big TV while Mum checked that their subscription was still active. The season premiere had aired the week before, and everyone agreed it was the best one yet. Tonight's episode ended on a cliffhanger — the main character was trapped in a cave with no way out. The children groaned. 'Can we watch one more?' they begged. Dad laughed and agreed, since the show was available on demand. They watched another episode before bed. On Saturday morning, he caught his son watching a rerun of the very first episode on his tablet — clearly, the whole family was ready to binge-watch the entire series all over again.
